name: i18n-zh-cjk-rendering
description: Задача f7dba88c: китайский каталог zh.ts (упрощённый zh-CN) зарегистрирован. Проверяется пользовательский путь «Все настройки → Клиент → 中文 → 应用»: живая смена языка без перезапуска, китайские подписи закладок, меню, кнопок, диалогов и таблиц без сырых ключей словаря и без кириллицы (кроме эндонимов языков), а также CJK-рендеринг: реально установленный CJK-шрифт, отсутствие «тофу» (глиф совпадает с .notdef), отсутствие обрезания и переносов в кнопках/вкладках/диалогах/таблицах (scrollWidth <= clientWidth, scrollHeight <= clientHeight), шрифтовые метрики строки. Запуск: npm -w @etn/server run build && npm -w @etn/client run build && node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.f7dba88c-i18n-zh.scenario.json --out .tmp/f7dba88c/run1

steps.name: open-settings
steps.eval: (() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')).find((e) => ['Настройки', 'Settings', '设置'].includes((e.textContent || '').trim())); if (!row) throw new Error('нет пункта настроек'); row.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); row.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return true; })()

steps.name: open-client-section-baseline
steps.eval: (() => { const nav = document.querySelectorAll('.settings-nav-item'); if (nav.length < 3) throw new Error('нет третьего раздела настроек (Client)'); nav[2].click(); return (nav[2].textContent || '').trim(); })()

steps.name: baseline-pick-ru
steps.eval: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('input[name="settings-lang"][value="ru"]'); if (!r) throw new Error('нет локали ru'); r.click(); return r.checked; })()

steps.name: baseline-apply-ru
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.settings-footer-buttons button')).find((e) => ['Apply', 'Применить', '应用'].includes((e.textContent || '').trim())); if (!b) throw new Error('нет кнопки Apply/Применить/应用'); b.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: lang-before
steps.probe: document.documentElement.lang

steps.name: lang-labels-before
steps.probe: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.settings-section label')).map((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim()).filter((s) => ['Русский', 'English', 'Китайский', '中文'].includes(s))

steps.name: pick-chinese
steps.eval: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('input[name="settings-lang"][value="zh"]'); if (!r) throw new Error('нет локали zh'); r.click(); return r.checked; })()

steps.name: chinese-picked
steps.probe: document.querySelector('input[name="settings-lang"]:checked')?.value ?? null

steps.name: apply-chinese
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.settings-footer-buttons button')).find((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim() === 'Применить'); if (!b) throw new Error('нет кнопки «Применить»'); b.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: live-lang-applied
steps.waitFor: document.documentElement.lang === 'zh' && document.querySelector('.dialog-title')?.textContent === '所有设置' && (() => { const labels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar > :last-child .tb-label')); return labels.length > 0 && labels[labels.length - 1].textContent === '想法网络'; })()

steps.name: tabs-after
steps.probe: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar button.view-tab')).map((b) => b.getAttribute('title'))

steps.name: nav-after
steps.probe: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.settings-nav-item')).map((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim())

steps.name: footer-buttons-after
steps.probe: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.settings-footer-buttons button')).map((b) => (b.textContent || '').trim())

steps.name: lang-labels-after
steps.probe: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.settings-section label')).map((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim()).filter((s) => ['Русский', 'English', '中文'].includes(s))

steps.name: chrome-no-cyrillic
steps.probe: (() => { const nodes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.settings-nav-item'), ...document.querySelectorAll('.settings-footer-buttons button'), ...Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar button.view-tab')).map((b) => ({ textContent: b.getAttribute('title') }))]; return nodes.filter((n) => /[А-Яа-яЁё]/.test(n.textContent || '')).map((n) => n.textContent); })()

steps.name: no-raw-dictionary-keys
steps.probe: (() => { const text = document.querySelector('.dialog-backdrop')?.innerText ?? ''; return (text.match(/\b(actions|dialog|list|common|state|table|propertyList|workspace|settings|settingsLogs|userMenu|menu|editor|diary|structures|publications|publication|filter|trash|admin|comment|attachments|chrono)\.[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]+/g) ?? []); })()

steps.name: cjk-fonts-detail
steps.probe: (() => { const candidates = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Han Sans SC', 'WenQuanYi Micro Hei', 'SimSun', 'Microsoft JhengHei']; const installed = candidates.filter((f) => document.fonts.check('16px "' + f + '"')); const body = getComputedStyle(document.body); return { installed, uiFamily: body.fontFamily, uiFontVar: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--user-font-ui').trim(), monoFontVar: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--md-mono').trim() }; })()

steps.name: cjk-no-tofu
steps.probe: (() => { const canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = 64; canvas.height = 64; const g = canvas.getContext('2d'); const draw = (ch) => { g.clearRect(0, 0, 64, 64); g.font = '32px system-ui, sans-serif'; g.fillStyle = '#000'; g.fillText(ch, 8, 40); return g.getImageData(0, 0, 64, 64).data; }; const han = draw('汉'); const notdef = draw('\uE123'); let ink = 0; let diff = 0; for (let i = 3; i < han.length; i += 4) { if (han[i] !== 0) ink += 1; if (han[i] !== notdef[i]) diff += 1; } return { inkPixels: ink, differsFromNotdef: diff, tofu: ink > 0 && diff === 0 }; })()

steps.name: cjk-glyph-width
steps.probe: (() => { const g = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d'); g.font = '16px system-ui, sans-serif'; const han = g.measureText('汉').width; const full = g.measureText('想法网络').width; return { han, full, sane: han >= 10 && han <= 24 }; })()

steps.name: chrome-clipping
steps.probe: (() => { const sel = '.ui-btn, .view-tab, .settings-nav-item, .settings-footer-buttons button, .dialog-title, .tb-label, .menu-item'; const out = []; for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(sel)) { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width <= 0 || r.height <= 0) continue; const sx = el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1; const sy = el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 1; if (sx || sy) out.push({ cls: typeof el.className === 'string' ? el.className : '', text: (el.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 40), sw: el.scrollWidth, cw: el.clientWidth, sh: el.scrollHeight, ch: el.clientHeight }); } return out; })()

steps.name: no-page-horizontal-overflow
steps.probe: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth + 1

steps.name: font-metrics-sane
steps.probe: (() => { const out = []; for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('.ui-btn, .view-tab, .settings-nav-item, .settings-footer-buttons button, .dialog-title, .tb-label, .diary-add-btn, .pub-toolbar button')) { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width <= 0 || r.height <= 0) continue; const cs = getComputedStyle(el); const fs = parseFloat(cs.fontSize); const lh = cs.lineHeight === 'normal' ? fs * 1.2 : parseFloat(cs.lineHeight); if (lh < fs - 0.5) out.push({ cls: typeof el.className === 'string' ? el.className : '', text: (el.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 40), fontSize: fs, lineHeight: lh }); } return out; })()

steps.name: open-activity
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar button.view-tab')).find((e) => e.getAttribute('title') === '事件'); if (!b) throw new Error('нет закладки 事件'); b.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: activity-headers-zh
steps.probe: (() => { const grid = document.querySelector('.activity-results vaadin-grid'); if (!grid) return { found: false }; const headers = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('vaadin-grid-sort-column')).map((c) => (c.header || '').trim()); return { found: true, headers, cyrillic: headers.filter((s) => /[А-Яа-яЁё]/.test(s)) }; })()

steps.name: activity-table-no-overflow
steps.probe: (() => { const grid = document.querySelector('.activity-results vaadin-grid'); if (!grid) return { found: false }; const content = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('vaadin-grid-cell-content')); const headerCells = content.slice(0, 5).map((c) => { const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); return { text: (c.textContent || '').trim(), width: Math.round(r.width), height: Math.round(r.height), clipX: c.scrollWidth > c.clientWidth + 1, clipY: c.scrollHeight > c.clientHeight + 1 }; }); const clipped = headerCells.filter((c) => c.clipX || c.clipY); return { found: true, headerCells: headerCells.length, texts: headerCells.map((c) => c.text), clipped, overflowX: grid.scrollWidth > grid.clientWidth + 1 }; })()

steps.name: close-settings
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.settings-footer-buttons button')).find((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim() === '取消'); if (!b) throw new Error('нет кнопки 取消'); b.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: user-menu-items-zh
steps.probe: (() => { const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')).map((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim()); return { hasSettings: items.includes('设置'), hasAbout: items.includes('关于'), hasDisconnect: items.includes('断开连接'), cyrillic: items.filter((s) => /[А-Яа-яЁё]/.test(s)) }; })()

steps.name: open-structures
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar button.view-tab')).find((e) => e.getAttribute('title') === '想法结构'); if (!b) throw new Error('нет закладки 想法结构'); b.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: structures-commands-zh
steps.probe: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.ff-extra--commands'); return { text: (el?.textContent || '').trim(), cyrillic: /[А-Яа-яЁё]/.test(el?.textContent || '') }; })()

steps.name: open-diary
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar button.view-tab')).find((e) => e.getAttribute('title') === '日记'); if (!b) throw new Error('нет закладки 日记'); b.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: diary-add-zh
steps.probe: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.diary-add-btn'); return { text: (el?.textContent || '').trim(), cyrillic: /[А-Яа-яЁё]/.test(el?.textContent || '') }; })()

steps.name: open-publications
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar button.view-tab')).find((e) => e.getAttribute('title') === '出版物'); if (!b) throw new Error('нет закладки 出版物'); b.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: publications-chrome-zh
steps.probe: (() => { const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.pub-toolbar button')).map((b) => (b.textContent || '').trim()).filter((s) => s !== ''); const search = document.querySelector('.pub-toolbar input[type=search]'); return { buttons, searchPlaceholder: search?.placeholder ?? null, cyrillic: /[А-Яа-яЁё]/.test((document.querySelector('.pub-toolbar')?.textContent || '')) }; })()

steps.name: open-publication-wizard
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.pub-toolbar button')).find((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim() === '出版物'); if (!b) throw new Error('нет кнопки 出版物'); b.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: wizard-chrome-zh
steps.probe: (() => { const labelsAll = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-backdrop .form-stack label')).map((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim()); const chrome = [document.querySelector('.dialog-title')?.textContent ?? '', ...labelsAll, ...Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-footer button')).map((b) => (b.textContent || '').trim())].join(' | '); return { title: document.querySelector('.dialog-title')?.textContent ?? null, buttons: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-footer button')).map((b) => (b.textContent || '').trim()), fields: labelsAll.filter((s) => ['名称', '标题', '副标题', '作者'].includes(s)), cyr: chrome.match(/[А-Яа-яЁё].*/g) }; })()

steps.name: wizard-clipping
steps.probe: (() => { const sel = '.dialog-backdrop .ui-btn, .dialog-backdrop .dialog-title, .dialog-backdrop .form-stack label, .dialog-footer button'; const out = []; for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(sel)) { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width <= 0 || r.height <= 0) continue; if (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1 || el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 1) out.push({ text: (el.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 40), sw: el.scrollWidth, cw: el.clientWidth, sh: el.scrollHeight, ch: el.clientHeight }); } return out; })()

steps.name: close-wizard
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-footer button')).find((e) => (e.textContent || '').trim() === '取消'); if (!b) throw new Error('нет кнопки 取消 в мастере'); b.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: lang-after
steps.probe: document.documentElement.lang

steps.name: network-data-not-translated
steps.probe: document.body.innerText.includes('GUI-стенд')

steps.name: final-chrome-clipping
steps.probe: (() => { const sel = '.ui-btn, .view-tab, .pub-toolbar button, .tb-label, .diary-add-btn, .ff-extra--commands'; const out = []; for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(sel)) { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width <= 0 || r.height <= 0) continue; if (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1 || el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 1) out.push({ text: (el.textContent || '').trim().slice(0, 40), sw: el.scrollWidth, cw: el.clientWidth, sh: el.scrollHeight, ch: el.clientHeight }); } return out; })()
